senses.meaning: Quả/trái bơ
examples: Avocados are rich in healthy monounsaturated fats.
She spread mashed avocado on toast for breakfast.
The avocado tree takes several years to bear its first fruit.

senses.meaning: Quả chanh xanh (lime); cây chanh; vôi (khoáng chất dùng trong nông nghiệp)
examples: Squeeze some lime juice over the tacos for extra freshness.
A gin and tonic with a slice of lime is a classic drink.
The farmer spread lime on the fields to reduce soil acidity.

note: 'Lime' (chanh xanh) ≠ 'lemon' (chanh vàng). Lime phổ biến trong ẩm thực Đông Nam Á.

senses.meaning: Tỏi
examples: She fried the garlic in olive oil until it turned golden.
Garlic is a staple ingredient in Mediterranean and Asian cooking.
The recipe calls for three cloves of garlic, finely minced.

note: Đơn vị đếm: 'a clove of garlic' (tép tỏi); 'a bulb of garlic' (củ tỏi).

senses.meaning: Ớt, quả ớt cay
examples: The curry was packed with fresh red chillies.
She grows red and green chillies in her garden.
This chilli paste is extremely spicy — use it sparingly.

note: Chính tả: 'chilli' (Anh Anh), 'chili' (Mỹ), 'chile' (Tây Ban Nha/Mỹ Latin). Database dùng 'chilli'.

senses.meaning: Tán lá, lá cây (của một cây hoặc cả khu vực)
examples: The autumn foliage in New England is breathtakingly spectacular.
The foliage of the old oak tree provides shade all summer long.
This plant is valued mainly for its attractive, variegated foliage.

senses.meaning: Nấm (sinh vật không quang hợp — gồm nấm ăn, nấm mốc, và nấm gây bệnh)
examples: A fungus can be either beneficial or destructive to plants.
Athlete's foot is caused by a type of fungus on the skin.
Some fungi are edible and delicious; others are deadly poisonous.

note: Số nhiều: 'fungi' (/ˈfʌŋɡaɪ/) — dạng học thuật; 'funguses' — dạng thông thường.

senses.meaning: Nấm (thường chỉ quả thể nấm ăn được)
examples: She sliced the mushrooms and added them to the omelette.
Wild mushrooms must be carefully identified before eating.
The forest floor was covered with mushrooms after the autumn rain.

senses.meaning: Tăng trưởng nhanh chóng, mọc lên như nấm
examples: New startups have mushroomed in the technology sector over the past decade.
Social media usage mushroomed during the pandemic lockdowns.
Housing prices have mushroomed since the central bank lowered interest rates.

senses.meaning: Nhiều cỏ dại; (người) gầy còm, yếu đuối (informal)
examples: The neglected garden had become weedy and completely overgrown.
He was a weedy little boy who was often bullied at school.
The pond looked weedy and unkempt after a summer of no maintenance.

senses.meaning: Thụ phấn (chuyển phấn hoa từ nhị sang nhụy)
examples: Bees pollinate flowers as they search for nectar.
Many crops depend entirely on insects to pollinate them.
Without bees to pollinate them, many plants cannot produce fruit or seeds.

senses.meaning: Mầm, chồi cây; mầm giá đỗ
examples: The seeds produced their first sprouts after three days of watering.
Bean sprouts are a popular ingredient in Asian noodle dishes.
Brussels sprouts are a type of miniature cabbage cooked as a vegetable.

senses.meaning: Nảy mầm, mọc lên; (tóc, râu) mọc nhanh
examples: The seeds sprouted within a week of being planted.
He sprouted a beard during the long lockdown period.
New businesses have sprouted up all across the city centre.

senses.meaning: Đồng cỏ dùng để chăn thả gia súc
examples: The cows were grazing in the lush green pasture at sunrise.
The farm has 200 acres of pasture land.
Put the horses out to pasture before sunset.

note: 'Put out to pasture' (idiom) = cho nghỉ hưu (người hoặc thiết bị cũ).

senses.meaning: Đồng cỏ, bãi cỏ (thường có hoa dại, không chăn thả)
examples: The children played in the meadow on warm summer afternoons.
Wildflowers filled the meadow with colour every spring.
The village sits in a peaceful valley surrounded by rolling meadows.

note: 'Meadow' thường gợi hình ảnh lãng mạn, tự nhiên hơn 'pasture' (mang tính canh tác hơn).

senses.meaning: Bắp cải
examples: She shredded the cabbage for a fresh, crunchy coleslaw.
Stuffed cabbage leaves are a traditional dish in Eastern Europe.
Red cabbage is often pickled and served alongside cold meats.

senses.meaning: Hoa, bông hoa; thời kỳ rực rỡ, đỉnh cao
examples: The cherry trees were in full bloom throughout April.
She was in the bloom of youth when she met him.
The garden was filled with colourful blooms in late spring.

senses.meaning: Nở hoa; phát triển rực rỡ, thăng hoa
examples: The roses bloom every spring without fail.
She really bloomed during her years at university.
His talent bloomed under the guidance of a talented mentor.

senses.meaning: Quả dừa; cùi dừa; nước dừa
examples: Coconut milk is a key ingredient in many Southeast Asian curries.
She cracked open a fresh coconut on the beach.
Coconut oil is widely used in both cooking and cosmetics.

senses.meaning: Gốc cây (phần còn lại sau khi cây bị chặt hoặc gãy)
examples: The old oak tree had been cut down, leaving only a mossy stump.
Children love to play on the tree stumps in the forest.
The ball hit the stump and the batsman was given out.

senses.meaning: Làm bối rối, không thể trả lời; đi lại nặng nề
examples: The question completely stumped me — I had no idea at all.
The puzzle stumped even the most experienced crossword players.
He stumped off angrily without saying a word to anyone.
